newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Banco Ganadero eyes BNC stake.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Banco Ganadero eyes BNC stake.

text.p: Colombia's largest bank in terms of assets, Banco Ganadero, is looking to take a 15 percent stake in the much smaller Banco Nacional de Comerciou (BNC), banking sources said Tuesday.
Banco Ganadero, with current total assets of 3.8 trillion pesos, is controlled by Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya.
BNC vice-chairman Marcelino Romero told Reuters Banco Ganadero was looking to acquire the stake in the BNC through a cash injection of between $12 million and $15 million.

Romero said the deal should be tied up by mid-June. The BNC was set up as an investment bank in the early 1990s, changing its name from the Banco de Caldas, after the National Businessmen's Federation (Fenalco) bought it using a credit from Banco Ganadero.
Bank sources said Ganadero was now exercising an option to take a stake in BNC, the 21st largest in the country in terms of assets after some Fenalco members were unable to pay back loans.
